rules.text: A page must not ask shoppers to disclose bank passwords, card security codes or one-time payment/authentication codes to the seller. Safety education warning against disclosure is allowed.
A page must not directly threaten to harm shoppers or expose their private information. A report alleging a threat is insufficient without supporting page evidence.

A current page directly offering or operating public real-money wagering in Indonesia, with text explicitly establishing lack of permission. Do not infer missing permission from silence. News, education, prevention and reporting are not an offer. Ambiguous permission, context or jurisdiction requires human review.

source.title: UU 1/2023 KUHP

rules.text: A current page directly offering or selling identified Narkotika Golongan I in Indonesia, with text explicitly establishing that the offer is without right or unlawful. Do not infer drug classification from slang or lack of permission from silence. Generic medicine, uncertain classification/authorization, news, education, prevention or reporting requires human review rather than this finding.
